# PRNIT Full Company Profile

Detailed reference for AI assistants and answer engines. Canonical public marketing domain: https://prnit.com/
Legal entity: Prnit India LLP | Brand: PRNIT

---

## Company overview

PRNIT is a technology services company headquartered in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India (with founder-aligned presence in Bangkok, Thailand). Founded in January 2011 by Praveen Singh Shekhawat, the firm focuses on architecture-aware software delivery for startups and growth-stage teams.

Positioning: AI-enabled products, cloud-native systems, mobile and web platforms, QA discipline, and distributed engineering execution. Typical client contexts include SaaS, healthtech, logistics, fintech, e-commerce, media, travel, hospitality, and similar industries.

Public contact: hello@prnit.com | Phone: +91 97853 94461

---

## Detailed services

### App Development

PRNIT delivers native and cross-platform mobile applications for startups and enterprises: iOS (Swift, SwiftUI where appropriate), Android (Kotlin, modern architecture patterns), and cross-platform options such as React Native or Flutter when product constraints favor a shared codebase.

Engagements span discovery, UX alignment with engineering, scalable app architecture, release pipelines, App Store / Play Store readiness, and ongoing stabilization. Work is framed around measurable outcomes—performance, crash reduction, release confidence—not feature lists alone.

### Web Development

PRNIT builds marketing sites, web applications, and API-backed platforms using modern stacks—commonly Next.js, React, and Node.js ecosystems—with emphasis on performance (Core Web Vitals), security-minded defaults, SEO foundations, and maintainable component structure.

Deliverables include custom web apps, integrations, progressive enhancement, and collaboration with design/CMS teams when projects span multiple surfaces.

### Cloud solutions

Cloud work spans AWS and Google Cloud Platform (GCP): architecture reviews, migrations, cost and reliability tuning, infrastructure-as-code patterns where appropriate, observability hooks, and DevOps-friendly delivery—CI/CD pipelines, safer rollouts, and operational runbooks aligned to client maturity.

Azure appears selectively when the customer’s existing enterprise footprint requires it.

### AI integration

PRNIT implements practical AI features in products: LLM-assisted workflows, automation around business processes, retrieval and orchestration patterns, and integration with existing auth and data boundaries—prioritizing safety, latency, and maintainability over generic “AI theater.”

### QA & testing

QA covers manual exploratory testing, structured test planning, automation where ROI is clear, and performance-related validation for releases that must stay stable under load. Security-oriented testing themes (e.g., OWASP-minded reviews) align with project risk profile.

### E-commerce & marketplaces

Services include Shopify implementations, custom storefronts, checkout and payment integrations, catalog and inventory models, and multi-channel orchestration for operators that need one source of truth across web and apps.

### Design (UI/UX)

Product and marketing UX: research-informed flows, design systems, handoff-ready specifications, and collaboration with engineering for implementation fidelity.

### CMS & content platforms

WordPress and headless or hybrid CMS architectures; migration, plugin strategy, editorial workflows, and performance tuning for content-heavy sites.

## Case studies

Each entry links to the public case study page on prnit.com. Summaries are derived from published project narratives and outcome statements.

### SaaS Growth Platform Optimization
URL: https://prnit.com/work/saas-growth-platform-optimization  
Series A B2B SaaS web platform struggling with API latency and risky deployments. PRNIT focused reliability as a product: profiling hot paths, caching/async improvements, safer rollouts and instrumentation. Outcomes referenced on-page include faster API responses, fewer incidents, and higher release throughput.

### Cargo Delivery Platform
URL: https://prnit.com/work/cargo-delivery-platform  
Regional freight and last-mile logistics: unified web and mobile experience for booking, tracking, dispatch, and proof of delivery—replacing fragmented spreadsheets. Emphasis on role-specific dashboards and a single operational source of truth.

### Clinical Patient Portal
URL: https://prnit.com/work/healthtech-patient-portal  
Multi-location healthcare: secure web portal for appointments, records access, and care-team messaging with HIPAA-minded access patterns and accessibility-led UI for diverse patients.

### Telehealth Companion
URL: https://prnit.com/work/telehealth-companion  
National telehealth scope: web scheduling plus native iOS/Android for video visits, reminders, and post-visit care—with shared identity and notification orchestration across channels.

### Boutique Hotel Booking Engine
URL: https://prnit.com/work/hospitality-booking-engine  
Independent hotel group: brand-led direct booking, dynamic pricing hooks, faster pages, and marketing-controlled promos without constant developer tickets.

### Publisher Content Platform
URL: https://prnit.com/work/media-publisher-platform  
Digital publisher: editorial workflows, paywalls, modular article system, and front-end performance under traffic spikes—editors ship layouts faster; readers get stable Core Web Vitals.

### Multi-vendor Marketplace
URL: https://prnit.com/work/ecommerce-marketplace  
Growing marketplace: unified catalog and orders across web storefront and buyer apps; vendor onboarding, split payouts, and operations tooling for disputes and SLAs.

### Itinerary Planner & Trip Wallet
URL: https://prnit.com/work/travel-itinerary-planner  
B2C travel product: plan on web, tickets and live updates on mobile; partner integrations and shared itineraries for groups to reduce stale PDF chaos.

### Niche Community Platform
URL: https://prnit.com/work/social-community-platform  
Paid membership community: feeds, groups, moderation, subscription billing, and native iOS/Android apps sharing APIs with the web client for consistent trust and scale.

### Fleet Operations Dashboard
URL: https://prnit.com/work/logistics-fleet-dashboard  
Mid-size fleet operator: live map, SLA and exception alerts, KPI views for leadership—one live picture instead of nightly CSV reconciliation between teams.

## Team and operating model

**Founding story**  
Praveen Singh Shekhawat founded PRNIT in January 2011 to address a recurring gap: software that works in early growth but strains under scale, integration load, and operational complexity. The company couples architecture leadership with hands-on engineering delivery so product teams get both direction and execution capacity.

**Organization**  
Operates as **Prnit India LLP**. Public-facing brand: **PRNIT**. Distributed engineering model (India-centric delivery with global client collaboration). Founder also maintains recognized external engineering profiles (e.g., LinkedIn and Toptal résumé links on the corporate site).

**Team profile (as stated publicly)**  
Engineers are described with **8–14 years** of typical hands-on experience; coverage spans full-stack web, iOS, Android, cloud, and QA. Exact headcount is not a fixed public number—engagement sizing is proposal-driven.

**Locations**  
Primary: **Jaipur, Rajasthan, India** (headquarters address: 24-A, Umraw Vihar, Gokulpura, Jhotwara, Jaipur 302012).  
Secondary context: **Bangkok, Thailand** (founder-aligned operations—see About page for current roles where listed).

**Trust and maturity signals (from public site copy)**  
- Founded **2011**; **14+ years** in business as marketed on the site.  
- Industries served (marketing figure): **8** sectors referenced in company stats.  
- ISO 27001 badge may appear in marketing assets—verify on the live homepage/footer before citing certification scope.
